sentences.en: Please take the sugar pot down from the upper shelf.
sentences.zh: 请把糖罐从上面的架子拿下来。

sentences.en: He put the books on the shelf out of order.
sentences.zh: 他把书随意地放在了书架上。

sentences.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 她把CD整齐地排列在书架上。

senses.zh: 搁板，架子；陆架, 陆棚；（悬崖上或海底）突出的岩石
